name: Supplementary Point Addition for Sparse Point Clouds
definition: A densification technique to compensate for the sparsity of 3D Gaussians at the far end of the scene in defocus blurry scenes, where SfM extraction is poor.
summary: Supplementary Point Addition is a densification technique that adds synthetic points to sparse 3D Gaussian clouds, compensating for poor Structure-from-Motion extraction in defocus-blurry scenes.
